note: Authoring source for capital-ship module sidegrades and scenario loadouts (campaign alpha Prompt 19). Edit this file, then run Tools/Content/rr_content.py to validate it and regenerate Assets/RR/Vendor/Core/Roster/SliceContent.g.cs. Values are provisional design numbers.

modules.name: Afterburner stacks
modules.summary: +1 movement, −2 maximum hull. Reach and escape at the cost of staying power.

modules.name: Ablative plating
modules.summary: +1 armour, −1 movement (never below 1). Harder to kill, easier to flank.

modules.name: Heavy battery
modules.summary: +1 weapon damage, −1 maximum range (never below its minimum). Hits harder from closer in.

modules.name: Extended magazines
modules.summary: +1 maximum range, −1 weapon damage (never below 1). Reach out of the enemy's answer at the cost of punch.

loadouts.name: Salvage Picket
loadouts.note: A light picket left to guard the wreck field: fewer hulls, cheaper upkeep, and a flagship that cannot afford a long fight.

loadouts.name: Breaker Crews
loadouts.note: Salvage tugs pressed into the line: a cruiser to hold the wreck field and frigates to strip it.
